verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֖ם שְׁכֶ֑ם כִּ֥י שְׁכֶ֛ם בָּ֥א כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām šə·ḵem kî šə·ḵem bā ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl lə·ham·lîḵ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem for all Israel had gone there to make him king
verses.literalPt: E FOI Roboão para Siquém; porque todo o Israel se reuniu em Siquém, para o fazerem rei.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ׀ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֗ט וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְמִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֔ח מִפְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ wə·hū ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer bā·raḥ mip·pə·nê ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh way·yê·šeḇ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this he was still in Egypt where he had fled from King Solomon and had been living ever since
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu que, Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, achando-se ainda no Egito, para onde fugira de diante do rei Salomão, voltou do Egito,

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ וַיִּקְרְאוּ־ ל֔וֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ יָרָבְעָ֖ם וְכָל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū way·yiq·rə·’ū- lōw way·yå̄·ḇō·ʾū yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām wə·ḵāl qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl way·ḏab·bə·rū ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: So they sent for . . . Jeroboam and he and the whole assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam and said . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque mandaram chamá-lo; veio, pois, Jeroboão e toda a congregação de Israel, e falaram a Roboão, dizendo:

verses.original: אָבִ֖יךָ הִקְשָׁ֣ה אֶת־ עֻלֵּ֑נוּ וְאַתָּ֡ה עַתָּ֣ה הָקֵל֩ מֵעֲבֹדַ֨ת אָבִ֜יךָ הַקָּשָׁ֗ה וּמֵעֻלּ֧וֹ הַכָּבֵ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן עָלֵ֖ינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hiq·šāh ’eṯ- ‘ul·lê·nū wə·’at·tāh ‘at·tāh hā·qêl mê·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā haq·qā·šāh ū·mê·‘ul·lōw hak·kā·ḇêḏ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan ‘ā·lê·nū wə·na·‘aḇ·ḏe·kā
verses.literal: Your father put a heavy yoke on us But now you must lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us and we will serve you
verses.literalPt: Teu pai agravou o nosso jugo; agora, pois, alivia tu a dura servidão de teu pai, e o pesado jugo que nos impôs, e nós te serviremos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכ֥וּ עֹ֛ד שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלָ֑י וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem lə·ḵū ‘ōḏ šə·lō·šāh yā·mîm wə·šū·ḇū ’ê·lāy way·yê·lə·ḵū hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Rehoboam answered Go away for three days and then return to me So the people departed
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Ide-vos até ao terceiro dia, e então voltai a mim. E o povo se foi.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֞ץ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת־ הַזְּקֵנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הָי֣וּ עֹמְדִ֗ים אֶת־ פְּנֵי֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אָבִ֔יו בִּֽהְיֹת֥וֹ חַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֚יךְ אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ham·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ’eṯ- haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer- hā·yū ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ’eṯ- pə·nê šə·lō·mōh ’ā·ḇîw bih·yō·ṯōw ḥay lê·mōr ’êḵ ’at·tem nō·w·‘ā·ṣîm lə·hā·šîḇ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām- haz·zeh dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served . . . . . . his father Solomon during his lifetime How do you advise me to respond - to these people he asked
verses.literalPt: E teve o rei Roboão conselho com os anciãos que estiveram na presença de Salomão, seu pai, quando este ainda vivia, dizendo: Como aconselhais vós que se responda a este povo?

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־ הַ֠יּוֹם תִּֽהְיֶה־ עֶ֜בֶד לָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וַֽעֲבַדְתָּ֔ם וַעֲנִיתָ֕ם וְדִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְהָי֥וּ לְךָ֛ עֲבָדִ֖ים כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bēr ’ê·lāw lê·mōr ’im- hay·yō·wm tih·yeh- ‘e·ḇeḏ lā·‘ām haz·zeh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tām wa·‘ă·nî·ṯām wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ă·lê·hem də·ḇā·rîm ṭō·w·ḇîm wə·hā·yū lə·ḵā ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: They replied If you will be a servant to these people and serve them this day and if you will respond by speaking kind words to them they will be your servants forever . . .
verses.literalPt: E eles lhe falaram, dizendo: Se hoje fores servo deste povo, e o servires, e respondendo-lhe, lhe falares boas palavras, todos os dias serão teus servos.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת־ עֲצַ֥ת הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצֻ֑הוּ וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָעֹמְדִ֖ים לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣaṯ haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer yə·‘ā·ṣu·hū way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer gā·ḏə·lū ’it·tōw ’ă·šer hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders instead, he consulted . . . the young men who had grown up with him and served him
verses.literalPt: Porém ele deixou o conselho que os anciãos lhe tinham dado, e teve conselho com os jovens que haviam crescido com ele, que estavam diante dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם מָ֚ה אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים וְנָשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּר֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָקֵל֙ מִן־ הָעֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן אָבִ֖יךָ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem māh ’at·tem nō·w·‘ā·ṣîm wə·nā·šîḇ dā·ḇār ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·bə·rū ’ê·lay lê·mōr hā·qêl min- hā·‘ōl ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: He asked them What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me saying Lighten . . . the yoke your father put on us
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Que aconselhais vós que respondamos a este povo, que me falou, dizendo: Alivia o jugo que teu pai nos impôs?

verses.original: וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַ֣ר לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבְּר֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ לֵאמֹ֗ר אָבִ֙יךָ֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶת־ עֻלֵּ֔נוּ וְאַתָּ֖ה הָקֵ֣ל מֵעָלֵ֑ינוּ כֹּ֚ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קָֽטָנִּ֥י עָבָ֖ה מִמָּתְנֵ֥י אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·lāw hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer gā·ḏə·lū ’it·tōw lê·mōr kōh- ṯō·mar lā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·bə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hiḵ·bîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ul·lê·nū wə·’at·tāh hā·qêl mê·‘ā·lê·nū kōh tə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem qā·ṭān·nî ‘ā·ḇāh mim·mā·ṯə·nê ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: The young men who had grown up with him replied This is how you should answer these people who said to you . . . Your father made our yoke heavy but you must make it lighter This is what you should tell them My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist
verses.literalPt: E os jovens que haviam crescido com ele lhe falaram: Assim dirás a este povo que te falou: Teu pai fez pesadíssimo o nosso jugo, mas tu o alivia de sobre nós; assim lhe falarás: Meu dedo mínimo é mais grosso do que os lombos de meu pai.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אָבִי֙ הֶעְמִ֤יס עֲלֵיכֶם֙ עֹ֣ל כָּבֵ֔ד וַאֲנִ֖י אוֹסִ֣יף עַֽל־ עֻלְּכֶ֑ם אָבִ֗י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּשּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַקְרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·ḇî he‘·mîs ‘ă·lê·ḵem ‘ōl kā·ḇêḏ wa·’ă·nî ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘al- ‘ul·lə·ḵem ’ā·ḇî yis·sar ’eṯ·ḵem baš·šō·w·ṭîm wa·’ă·nî ’ă·yas·sêr ’eṯ·ḵem bā·‘aq·rab·bîm
verses.literal: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke I will add . . . to your yoke Whereas my father scourged you with whips I will scourge you with scorpions
verses.literalPt: Assim que, se meu pai vos carregou de um jugo pesado, ainda eu aumentarei o vosso jugo; meu pai vos castigou com açoites, porém eu vos castigarei com escorpiões.

verses.original: וַיָּבוֹ יָרָבְעָ֧ם וְכָל־ הָעָ֛ם אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֖ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר שׁ֥וּבוּ אֵלַ֖י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yå̄·ḇō yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ham·me·leḵ lê·mōr šū·ḇū ’ê·lay bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî
verses.literal: After three days Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam since the king . . . had said Come back to me on the third day
verses.literalPt: Veio, pois, Jeroboão e todo o povo, ao terceiro dia, a Roboão, como o rei havia ordenado, dizendo: Voltai a mim ao terceiro dia.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם קָשָׁ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת־ עֲצַ֥ת הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְעָצֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām qā·šāh way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣaṯ haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer yə·‘ā·ṣu·hū
verses.literal: And the king answered the people harshly He rejected the advice of the elders
verses.literalPt: E o rei respondeu ao povo duramente; porque deixara o conselho que os anciãos lhe haviam dado.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַיְלָדִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָבִי֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶֽת־ עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וַאֲנִ֖י אֹסִ֣יף עַֽל־ עֻלְּכֶ֑ם אָבִ֗י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּשּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַקְרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem ka·‘ă·ṣaṯ hay·lā·ḏîm lê·mōr ’ā·ḇî hiḵ·bîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ul·lə·ḵem wa·’ă·nî ’ō·sîp̄ ‘al- ‘ul·lə·ḵem ’ā·ḇî yis·sar ’eṯ·ḵem baš·šō·w·ṭîm wa·’ă·nî ’ă·yas·sêr ’eṯ·ḵem bā·‘aq·rab·bîm
verses.literal: and spoke to them as the young men had advised saying Whereas my father made your yoke heavy I will add to your yoke Whereas my father scourged you with whips I will scourge you with scorpions
verses.literalPt: E lhe falou conforme ao conselho dos jovens, dizendo: Meu pai agravou o vosso jugo, porém eu ainda aumentarei o vosso jugo; meu pai vos castigou com açoites, porém eu vos castigarei com escorpiões.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם כִּֽי־ הָיְתָ֤ה סִבָּה֙ מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־ דְּבָר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַשִּׁילֹנִ֔י אֶל־ יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־ נְבָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ham·me·leḵ ’el- hā·‘ām kî- hā·yə·ṯāh sib·bāh mê·‘im Yah·weh lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rōw ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh bə·yaḏ ’ă·ḥî·yāh haš·šî·lō·nî ’el- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ
verses.literal: So the king did not listen to the people and indeed this turn of events was from the LORD to fulfill the word He had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite
verses.literalPt: O rei, pois, não deu ouvidos ao povo; porque esta revolta vinha do SENHOR, para confirmar a palavra que o SENHOR tinha falado pelo ministério de Aías, o silonita, a Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּלֶךְ֮ אֲלֵיהֶם֒ וַיָּשִׁ֣בוּ הָעָ֣ם אֶת־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּבָ֣ר׀ לֵאמֹ֡ר מַה־ לָּנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק בְּדָוִ֜ד וְלֹֽא־ נַחֲלָ֣ה בְּבֶן־ יִשַׁ֗י לְאֹהָלֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַתָּ֕ה רְאֵ֥ה בֵיתְךָ֖ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar kāl- yiś·rā·’êl kî lō- šā·ma‘ ham·me·leḵ ’ă·lê·hem way·yā·ši·ḇū hā·‘ām ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·ḇār lê·mōr mah- lā·nū ḥê·leq bə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·lō- na·ḥă·lāh bə·ḇen- yi·šay lə·’ō·hā·le·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ‘at·tāh rə·’êh ḇê·ṯə·ḵā dā·wiḏ way·yê·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl lə·’ō·hā·lāw
verses.literal: When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them they answered the king . . . What portion do we have in David and what inheritance in the son of Jesse To your tents O Israel Look now to your own house O David So the Israelites went home
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, todo o Israel que o rei não lhe dava ouvidos, tornou-lhe o povo a responder, dizendo: Que parte temos nós com Davi? Não há para nós herança no filho de Jessé. Ás tuas tendas, ó Israel! Provê agora a tua casa, ó Davi. Então Israel se foi às suas tendas.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם רְחַבְעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lōḵ ‘ă·lê·hem rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām
verses.literal: but Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites . . . living in the cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: No tocante, porém, aos filhos de Israel que habitavam nas cidades de Judá, também sobre eles reinou Roboão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת־ אֲדֹרָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמַּ֔ס וַיִּרְגְּמ֨וּ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל בּ֛וֹ אֶ֖בֶן וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם הִתְאַמֵּץ֙ לַעֲל֣וֹת בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֔ה לָנ֖וּס יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·rām ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·mas way·yir·gə·mū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl bōw ’e·ḇen way·yā·mōṯ wə·ham·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām hiṯ·’am·mêṣ la·‘ă·lō·wṯ bam·mer·kā·ḇāh lā·nūs yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Then King Rehoboam sent out Adoram who was in charge of the forced labor but all Israel stoned . . . him to death And King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste and escaped to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Roboão enviou a Adorão, que estava sobre os tributos; e todo o Israel o apedrejou, e ele morreu; mas o rei Roboão se animou a subir ao carro para fugir para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּפְשְׁע֤וּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּבֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·šə·‘ū yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḇêṯ dā·wiḏ ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: So to this day Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David
verses.literalPt: Assim se rebelaram os israelitas contra a casa de Davi, até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁ֣ב יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֗וּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית־ דָּוִ֔ד זוּלָתִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ kāl- yiś·rā·’êl kî- šāḇ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām way·yiš·lə·ḥū way·yiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yam·lî·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl lō hā·yāh ’a·ḥă·rê ḇêṯ- dā·wiḏ zū·lā·ṯî šê·ḇeṭ- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ḇad·dōw
verses.literal: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned they summoned . . . him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel Only . . . the tribe of Judah followed the house of David
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo todo o Israel que Jeroboão tinha voltado, enviaram, e o chamaram para a congregação, e o fizeram rei sobre todo o Israel; e ninguém seguiu a casa de Davi senão somente a tribo de Judá.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹאוּ רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֣בֶט בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְהִלָּחֵם֙ עִם־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה לִרְחַבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yå̄·ḇō·ʾū rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām yə·rū·šā·lim way·yaq·hêl ’eṯ- kāl- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- šê·ḇeṭ bin·yā·min mê·’āh ū·šə·mō·nîm ’e·lep̄ bā·ḥūr ‘ō·śêh mil·ḥā·māh lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·hā·šîḇ ’eṯ- ham·mə·lū·ḵāh lir·ḥaḇ·‘ām ben- šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: And when Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem he mobilized the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin 180,000 . . . . . . chosen . . . warriors to fight against the house of Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon
verses.literalPt: Vindo, pois, Roboão a Jerusalém, reuniu toda a casa de Judá e a tribo de Benjamim, cento e oitenta mil escolhidos, destros para a guerra, para pelejar contra a casa de Israel, para restituir o reino a Roboão, filho de Salomão.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל־ שְׁמַעְיָ֥ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- šə·ma‘·yāh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lê·mōr
verses.literal: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God
verses.literalPt: Porém veio a palavra de Deus a Semaías, homem de Deus, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱמֹ֗ר אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ין וְיֶ֥תֶר הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ben- šə·lō·mōh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’el- kāl- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·mîn wə·ye·ṯer hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Tell . . . Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah all the house of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people . . .
verses.literalPt: Fala a Roboão, filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a toda a casa de Judá, e a Benjamim, e ao restante do povo, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹֽא־ תַעֲלוּ֩ וְלֹא־ תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּן עִם־ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ כִּ֧י מֵאִתִּ֛י נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֥בוּ לָלֶ֖כֶת כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lō- ṯa·‘ă·lū wə·lō- ṯil·lā·ḥă·mūn ‘im- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl šû·b̲û ’îš lə·ḇê·ṯōw kî mê·’it·tî nih·yāh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh way·yā·šu·ḇū lā·le·ḵeṯ kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: that this is what the LORD says You are not to go up . . . and fight against your brothers the Israelites . . . Each of you must return home for this is My doing So they listened to the word of the LORD and turned back . . . according to the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não subireis nem pelejareis contra vossos irmãos, os filhos de Israel; volte cada um para a sua casa, porque eu é que fiz esta obra. E ouviram a palavra do SENHOR, e voltaram segundo a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּ֨בֶן יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֛ם בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּ֑הּ וַיֵּצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֔ם וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־ פְּנוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ’eṯ- šə·ḵem bə·har ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yê·šeḇ bāh way·yê·ṣê miš·šām way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- pə·nū·’êl
verses.literal: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there And from there he went out and built Penuel
verses.literalPt: E Jeroboão edificou a Siquém, no monte de Efraim, e habitou ali; e saiu dali, e edificou a Penuel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּלִבּ֑וֹ עַתָּ֛ה תָּשׁ֥וּב הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām bə·lib·bōw ‘at·tāh tā·šūḇ ham·mam·lā·ḵāh lə·ḇêṯ dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Jeroboam said in his heart Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David
verses.literalPt: E disse Jeroboão no seu coração: Agora tornará o reino à casa de Davi.

verses.original: אִֽם־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה׀ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת זְבָחִ֤ים בְּבֵית־ יְהוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ֠שָׁב לֵ֣ב הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹ֣נֵיהֶ֔ם אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַהֲרָגֻ֕נִי וְשָׁ֖בוּ אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ya·‘ă·leh hā·‘ām haz·zeh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ zə·ḇā·ḥîm bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šāḇ lêḇ hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nê·hem ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh wa·hă·rā·ḡu·nî wə·šā·ḇū ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem their hearts . . . . . . will return to their lord Rehoboam king of Judah then they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah
verses.literalPt: Se este povo subir para fazer sacrifícios na casa do SENHOR, em Jerusalém, o coração deste povo se tornará a seu SENHOR, a Roboão, rei de Judá; e me matarão, e tornarão a Roboão, rei de Judá.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֣ץ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֖י עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם רַב־ לָכֶם֙ מֵעֲל֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ham·me·leḵ way·ya·‘aś šə·nê ‘eḡ·lê zā·hāḇ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem raḇ- lā·ḵem mê·‘ă·lō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hin·nêh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: After seeking advice the king made two golden calves and said to the people Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you Here O Israel are your gods who brought you up out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Assim o rei tomou conselho, e fez dois bezerros de ouro; e lhes disse: Muito trabalho vos será o subir a Jerusalém; vês aqui teus deuses, ó Israel, que te fizeram subir da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֖ד בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֖ד נָתַ֥ן בְּדָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl wə·’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ nā·ṯan bə·ḏān
verses.literal: One calf he set up in Bethel and the other in Dan
verses.literalPt: E pôs um em Betel, e colocou o outro em Dã.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה לְחַטָּ֑את וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֶחָ֖ד עַד־ דָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ way·yê·lə·ḵū hā·‘ām lip̄·nê hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘aḏ- dān
verses.literal: And this thing became a sin the people walked as far as Dan to worship before one of the calves
verses.literalPt: E este feito se tornou em pecado; pois que o povo ia até Dã para adorar o bezerro.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית בָּמ֑וֹת וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מִקְצ֣וֹת הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הָי֖וּ מִבְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- bêṯ bā·mō·wṯ way·ya·‘aś kō·hă·nîm miq·ṣō·wṯ hā·‘ām ’ă·šer lō- hā·yū mib·bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: Jeroboam also built shrines on the high places and appointed from every class of people priests who were not Levites . . .
verses.literalPt: Também fez casa nos altos; e constituiu sacerdotes dos mais baixos do povo, que não eram dos filhos de Levi.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ יָרָבְעָ֣ם׀ חָ֡ג בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֣י בַּחֲמִשָּֽׁה־ עָשָׂר֩ י֨וֹם׀ לַחֹ֜דֶשׁ כֶּחָ֣ג׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּיהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּ֙עַל֙ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל לְזַבֵּ֖חַ לָעֲגָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֑ה וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֵ֔ל אֶת־ כֹּהֲנֵ֥י הַבָּמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ḥāḡ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·mî·nî ba·ḥă·miš·šāh- ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš ke·ḥāḡ ’ă·šer bî·hū·ḏāh way·ya·‘al ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ kên ‘ā·śāh bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl lə·zab·bê·aḥ lā·‘ă·ḡā·lîm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ bə·ḇêṯ ’êl ’eṯ- kō·hă·nê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth . . . day of the eighth month like the feast that was in Judah and he offered sacrifices on the altar he made this offering in Bethel to sacrifice to the calves he had set up and he installed priests in Bethel for the high places he had set up
verses.literalPt: E fez Jeroboão uma festa no oitavo mês, no dia décimo quinto do mês, como a festa que se fazia em Judá, e sacrificou no altar; semelhantemente fez em Betel, sacrificando aos bezerros que fizera; também em Betel estabeleceu sacerdotes dos altos que fizera.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַל עַֽל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ׀ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּדָ֣א מִלִּבַּד וַיַּ֤עַשׂ חָג֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּ֥עַל עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לְהַקְטִֽיר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·mî·nî ba·ḥō·ḏeš ’ă·šer- bā·ḏā mil·lib·baḏ way·ya·‘aś ḥāḡ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘al ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lə·haq·ṭîr
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the eighth month a month of his own choosing . . . Jeroboam offered sacrifices on the altar he had set up in Bethel So he ordained a feast for the Israelites . . . offered sacrifices on the altar and burned incense
verses.literalPt: E sacrificou no altar que fizera em Betel, no dia décimo quinto do oitavo mês, que ele tinha imaginado no seu coração; assim fez a festa aos filhos de Israel, e sacrificou no altar, queimando incenso.
